collegeFullAddress: Symbiosis Knowledge Village, Gram Lavale, Tal Mulshi, Pune, Maharashtra 412115
collegeInfo: SIBM Pune, part of Symbiosis International (Deemed University), is a top B-School in India renowned for its academic excellence, global exposure, contemporary curriculum, and superb placement record. Located atop Pune's scenic Lavale hills, the campus provides a world-class environment for holistic management education.

scholarships.eligibilityCriteria: Based on academic excellence in first semester and/or family income as per university norms.
scholarships.applicationProcess: Awarded automatically based on merit and category. Application may be required for need-based awards.

scholarships.eligibilityCriteria: Category students as per Government of India rules.
scholarships.applicationProcess: Apply through government portals and validate with institute.

events.eventFullDescription: Transcend, the flagship annual fest of SIBM Pune, blends management competitions, cultural performances, workshops, entertainment nights, and celebrity events, attracting students from top B-schools across the country.

The E-Summit at SIBM Pune brings together entrepreneurs, venture capitalists, and leaders to inspire innovation and educate students through panel discussions, startup fairs, and business competitions.

infrastructure.infraDescription:
SIBM Pune is housed in a stunning hilltop campus with lush green surroundings and world-class infrastructure. The campus has smart classrooms, multiple seminar halls, a well-equipped central library, finance and analytics labs, recreational and sporting facilities, and excellent residential amenities.

Academic Infrastructure🏫

  • Smart classrooms and seminar halls with AV equipment and Wi-Fi.

  • Central and e-library with vast digital resources and business databases.

Residential Facilities🏨

  • Hostel accommodation with separate facilities for men and women, including mess and laundry services.

Recreation & Amenities☕

  • Multi-cuisine cafeterias, health club, meditation room, and medical center.

  • Sports complex with gym, swimming pool, and grounds for various sports.
